description: This file contains the implementation of a radix sort algorithm for sorting arrays of longs, including specialized methods for key-prefix arrays, within the Apache Spark project.

classes.name: RadixSort
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for performing radix sort on LongArray objects, including support for key-prefix arrays and configurable sorting options.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs a least-significant-digit radix sort on a LongArray, with options for byte range, order, and signedness.

methods.name: sortAtByte
methods.description: Performs sorting at a specific byte position within the array, used internally by the main sort method.

methods.name: getCounts
methods.description: Computes histograms of byte values for each byte position in the array to optimize sorting.

methods.name: transformCountsToOffsets
methods.description: Converts byte value counts into output offsets for rearranging data during sorting.

methods.name: sortKeyPrefixArray
methods.description: Sorts key-prefix arrays where each record has a key and a prefix, only sorting based on the prefix.

methods.name: getKeyPrefixArrayCounts
methods.description: Computes byte histograms specifically for key-prefix arrays.

methods.name: sortKeyPrefixArrayAtByte
methods.description: Performs byte-level sorting for key-prefix arrays at a specific byte position.
